title: 5 money habits that keep you poor without realizing

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 72% of people who struggle with money do this every day?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Inflation is eating away at your savings faster than you think.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You’re spending money on things that don’t build long-term value.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The habit is buying “stuff” that depreciates instantly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects millennials and Gen Z who spend $1,200 a month on non-essentials.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Invest in assets, not experiences.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one thing you’re buying that’s actually costing you?
